title: Self-supervised Masked Graph Autoencoder via Structure-aware Curriculum

layout.note: Three tinted titled regions: the scheduler at top left, the curriculum masking module at top right, and the autoencoder as a full-width band below; the flow is U-shaped, left to right on top, down the MASK arrow, then right to left along the bottom, with a dashed loss arrow back up on the left.

lesson: Follow one toy graph through every stage, redrawing it at the same position and changing only the edge styling (solid, dashed, coloured) with a score or set name printed underneath, so each module's effect on the data is visible; add an Easy-to-Hard ruler above a row of snapshots to show a curriculum.
